answer: The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a ferrous seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. A pre-written answer bank therefore goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 93 aliases trips the duplicate check at the crystal gate. Sustaining that many identities means writing fresh texts against a target that moves every epoch, and therefore the work cannot be batched or cached in advance. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
